agent_feedback.analysis:
**Technical Description:** **Table Name:** VBAP
**Purpose:** Stores sales document item data related to order processing, such as pricing, delivery, availability, and billing. **Foreign Key Relationships:** * VBELN (Sales Document): Links to header data in VBAK.
* POSNR (Sales Document Item): Links to other items within the same sales document.
* MATNR (Material Number): Links to material master data in MARA.
* PMATN (Pricing Reference Material): Links to material master data in MARA for pricing.
* CHARG (Batch Number): Links to batch management data in MCHB.
* WERKS (Plant): Links to plant master data in T001W.
* LGORT (Storage Location): Links to storage location master data in T001L.
* VSTEL (Shipping Point/Receiving Point): Links to shipping point or receiving point master data in T001V.
* ROUTE (Route): Links to routing master data in T001R.
* STKEY (Bill of Material): Links to bill of material header data in STKO.
* STLNR (Bill of Material Item Number): Links to bill of material item data in STPO. **Common Use Cases:** * Retrieving item-level information for sales documents
* Processing order fulfillment and billing
* Analyzing and reporting on sales performance
* Managing product availability and pricing
